scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
This is our advance base
to stop Morocc.
I'm a tracker
charged with leading my army
to Morocc's lair.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
这里是阻止莫洛克的先遣基地。
我是一名追踪者，
负责率领军队前往莫洛克的巢穴。

scripts.text:
Your backpack is too full
I can't talk to you!
scripts.translation:
你的背包太满了，
我无法与你交谈！

scripts.text:
You need to reach level 160 first
to enter the Red Flower!
scripts.translation:
你需要先达到160级，
才能进入红色花朵！

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
We're nowhere near close
to stopping Morocc's resurrection.
I can't sleep at night,
knowing Morocc is doing everything he can
to recover his strength.
Could you come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
我们离阻止莫洛克复活还差得远。
想到莫洛克正在竭尽全力恢复力量，
我整夜无法入睡。
你能明天再来吗？

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
I knew you'd return.
You look well-rested.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
我就知道你会回来的。
你看起来休息得很好。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
According to my intel,
Morocc is hiding out in this place,
recovering his strength.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
根据我的情报，
莫洛克正躲藏在这个地方，
恢复他的力量。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Fighting Morocc
takes more than a few warriors, no matter how strong they are.
I recommend you join forces with
as many comrades as you can find.
Are you ready to enter the Red Flower
where Morocc is believed to be hiding?
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
无论战士多么强大，
仅凭少数人无法战胜莫洛克。
我建议你尽可能多地
召集同志一起行动。
你准备好进入莫洛克据信藏身的
红色花朵了吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Come back
if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
如果你改变主意，
随时可以回来。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
is not open yet.
Please come back later
and try again.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
红色花朵的入口
尚未开启。
请稍后再来尝试。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
has opened.
It will only stay open for a while.
You'd better use it
while you can.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
红色花朵的入口
已经开启。
它只会开放一段时间。
你最好趁现在进去。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
This is our advance base
to stop Morocc.
I'm a tracker
charged with leading my army
to Morocc's lair.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
这里是阻止莫洛克的先遣基地。
我是一名追踪者，
负责率领军队前往莫洛克的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
After a painstaking search,
I've located
the place with the highest chance of
hiding Morocc inside.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
经过艰苦的搜寻，
我找到了莫洛克
最有可能藏身的地方。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
According to my intel,
Morocc is hiding out in this place,
trying to recover
his full strength.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
根据我的情报，
莫洛克正躲藏在这个地方，
试图恢复
他的全部力量。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Even though I've located this place myself,
I have to admit
that I'm not equipped to
explore it by myself.
I'm a tracker after all, not a fighter.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
虽然是我亲自找到的这个地方，
但我必须承认，
我没有能力独自探索它。
毕竟我是追踪者，不是格斗家。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
You look like
a warrior spoiling for
a good fight with Morocc,
and I think
you have a chance at winning it.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
你看起来像是一个
渴望与莫洛克一战的战士，
我认为你
有机会赢得这场战斗。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
How'd you like to
enter Morocc's lair,
defeat him,
and become the hero
who saved the world from evil?
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
你想不想
进入莫洛克的巢穴，
击败他，
成为拯救世界于邪恶的英雄？

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
If you're interested in my proposition,
let me talk to your party leader.
We'll discuss more details together.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
如果你对我的提议感兴趣，
让我与你的队伍首领谈谈。
我们会一起讨论更多细节。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Morocc may not have recovered his full strength, but fighting him still
takes more than a few warriors, no matter how strong they are.
I recommend you join forces with
as many comrades as you can find.
Are you ready to enter the Red Flower
where Morocc is believed to be hiding?
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
莫洛克可能尚未恢复全部力量，但战胜他
仍然需要众多战士，无论他们多么强大。
我建议你尽可能多地
召集同志一起行动。
你准备好进入莫洛克据信藏身的
红色花朵了吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Come back
if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
如果你改变主意，
随时可以回来。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
is not open yet.
Please come back later
and try again.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
红色花朵的入口
尚未开启。
请稍后再来尝试。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
has opened.
It will only stay open for a while.
You'd better use it
while you can.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
红色花朵的入口
已经开启。
它只会开放一段时间。
你最好趁现在进去。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Finally you're back!
What happened in there?
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
你终于回来了！
里面发生了什么？

scripts.text:
- You relay
your experience in the Red Flower. -
scripts.translation: - 你讲述在红色花朵中的经历。 -

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
So Morocc got away.
That's a shame.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
所以莫洛克逃走了。
真遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
At least
you wiped out
his army.
That's an accomplishment in itself.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
至少你消灭了
他的军队。
这本身
也是一项成就。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
At least we know
where he is.
Could you come back tomorrow
and help me track
him down again?
I'll be waiting here.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
至少我们知道了
他在哪里。
明天你能回来
帮我再次追踪
他的行踪吗？
我会在这里等你。
